additional_candidates.consequential_possibility: A blind or low-vision investigator can independently inspect numerical evidence and relationships in public charts and diagrams that otherwise rely on sight, using an accessible structured instrument rather than depending on a sighted interpreter.
additional_candidates.constraint_with_strongest_accessible_too: W3C documents that complex images need complete essential information, including values, structure, relationships and trends. Existing long descriptions, structured tables and accessible chart tools already address author-provided data. The unresolved candidate problem is trustworthy transformation where only an image remains, and measuring whether the resulting instrument preserves the intended evidence and supports the beneficiary task.
additional_candidates.recent_frontier_change: Current visual reasoning and code-construction tools can propose chart extraction and keyboard/screen-reader interfaces. Vendor visual benchmark gains motivate testing; they do not establish accurate arbitrary-chart interpretation or user benefit.
additional_candidates.missing_means_proposed: A source-grounded compiler from a bounded chart family to an accessible navigable data/relationship instrument, with independently checked data extraction, explicit unresolved values and task-relevant nonvisual acceptance. Build within existing artifact/interface tools, not a new accessibility platform.
additional_candidates.decisive_before_after: Independently select charts and investigator tasks, preserve source data for a separate exact checker, freeze an extraction/interaction policy and strongest existing accessible-chart alternative, then test numerical/relational correctness plus actual nonvisual task completion. Include charts with missing/ambiguous values that must be refused.
additional_candidates.first_commercial_delivery: A simulated buyer would receive actual transformed public chart evidence and a keyboard-operable instrument, accepted against both source truth and beneficiary task criteria. A WCAG scan or generated description alone would not establish the consequential outcome.
additional_candidates.valuable_family: Public-budget analysis, scientific education, audit evidence and data journalism with nonvisual access.
additional_candidates.beneficiary_demand_evidence: General accessibility need is supported by W3C guidance. No independently selected beneficiary, matched task benchmark, accepted budget or measured participation outcome is available in this bounded campaign.
additional_candidates.failed_condition: The campaign has no qualified source-truth/beneficiary-task bridge for arbitrary image-only evidence and has not constructed or tested a narrow substitute. Fully automatic checks cannot be claimed to establish all accessibility aspects. Narrowing to available source tables leaves a valuable conventional transformation without a demonstrated missing access capability.
additional_candidates.commercial_decision: No probe in this campaign; do not add fictional human review or divert protected completion resources.

primary_sources.summary: ReproZip traces operating-system calls to capture observed files, binaries and dependencies in a reproducibility bundle. Packing is Linux-only; unpacking can use multiple environments including virtual machines. This is an existing strong preservation method, not a new campaign invention.

Reproducibility is defined relative to specified source, environment, instructions and artifacts; exact byte comparison checks specified rebuilt artifacts. This does not by itself establish scientific truth, complete runtime state or current authority.
Build twice and compare outputs, then vary environment to expose hidden causes of nondeterminism. This provides a competent comparator for claimed replay/build capability.

Complex charts, diagrams and maps require text alternatives conveying essential information. Structured long descriptions may need values, scales, trends and relationships; a flat text-only reference can lose structure.

Automated tools help identify potential accessibility barriers but do not determine complete accessibility; some aspects require judgment and tools may be misleading. This limits broad automated conformance claims, without proving every bounded task needs human operation.

findings.observation: The implementation emits a source-checked target CSV snapshot, row differences and full original snapshot for rollback.
findings.decision_implication: Compare against ordinary full-snapshot replacement plus backup, a direct conventional implementation and an ordinary library carrying equivalent artifacts. Exact correctness can support commercial value without algorithmic superiority.

findings.observation: proof_digest is a SHA256 content digest over the package. verify_package recomputes expected construction from preserved sources.
findings.decision_implication: Describe integrity and checked semantics separately. The digest is not an authorized signature, universal formal proof or independently grounded buyer value.

findings.observation: apply_patch verifies the original snapshot hash; applying the same patch to its already-produced output generally refuses a stale/different source.
findings.decision_implication: This is safe refusal, not an idempotent-apply success claim. Enterprise unique-ID operation caching can supply process idempotency separately and requires its own test.
